name: Hindalco Industries Ltd.
business_summary: Aditya Birla Group metals flagship. Integrated India aluminium (captive bauxite/coal, Utkal and Aditya refineries, smelters, downstream rolled, foil, extrusions), copper smelter and recycling, plus Novelis, the world's largest aluminium rolled-products and can-sheet maker (N. America, Europe, Asia, S. America). Q1 FY27 (Jun 2026) sales Rs84,825 cr, EBITDA Rs13,932 cr (16%), record PAT Rs7,013 cr. TTM sales Rs295,537 cr, EBITDA Rs40,903 cr, PAT Rs16,400 cr; market cap Rs2.11 lakh cr; Q2 FY27 results due 2026-11-06.

revenue_mix.geography: N. America ~half of Novelis, Europe, Asia, S. America (model knowledge)

exposures.mechanism: Upstream India aluminium (primary ~1.3 Mt/yr, model knowledge) sold at LME-linked prices; +10% LME (~+$320/t at $3,200) x ~1.3 Mt x Rs94.5 = ~Rs3,900 cr/yr, ~10% of TTM EBITDA Rs40,903 cr (hedging/lags trim this). EV/MCap ~1.35 (net debt incl. Novelis, model knowledge), persistence 0.5 => ~+6.7, trimmed for hedges. Q1 FY27 India upstream EBITDA ~Rs7,400 cr (53% of consolidated Rs13,932 cr). Agrees with pack empirical +5.45 (t=+7.3).

evidence.note: AL Circle: Rs74 bn upstream aluminium EBITDA in Q1 FY27
CNBC TV18: MD sees aluminium at $3,200-3,400/t

exposures.mechanism: Hindalco is roughly self-sufficient to net-long alumina (Utkal and Aditya refineries, model knowledge), so a +15% alumina spike raises purchased-input cost only for the shortfall and Novelis is not alumina-linked; small net effect, sign uncertain (net sellers gain). Low confidence.

evidence.note: Business Today: alumina strategy unchanged after AluChem exit

exposures.mechanism: Power/fuel ~30% of smelting cost; captive coal blocks cover roughly half of coal need (model knowledge). +10% coal ~ +1.5-2% aluminium cash cost ~ $40/t x 1.3 Mt x 94.5 = ~Rs490 cr = ~1.2% EBITDA; x1.35 x0.5 => ~-0.8, widened for the uncovered portion.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 OPM 16% vs 12% year ago; cost split not in pack

exposures.mechanism: Copper smelter earns TC/RC and by-products (~Rs1,800-2,000 cr EBITDA/yr, model knowledge) with little direct LME exposure; stock tracks copper as a metals-basket proxy (empirical +2.42, t=+3.5, mostly co-movement). Weight kept low to avoid double counting with F_ALUMINIUM.

evidence.note: Trade Brains preview: copper earnings a Q2 driver

exposures.mechanism: India aluminium revenue (~Rs41k cr at LME x FX) is USD-linked while ~35% of costs are INR; +3% INR depreciation adds ~Rs800-1,200 cr EBITDA net, plus Novelis EBITDA translated up (~Rs470 cr), minus USD debt revaluation. Net ~+3% EBITDA x1.35 x0.5-0.75 => ~+2.

Novelis (~55% of group sales, N. America about half of Novelis) sells beverage-can, automotive and specialty sheet; +1pp US growth lifts volumes ~1% and EBITDA/tonne via mix => ~+1.5% equity. Oswego hot-mill recovery is the idiosyncratic swing.

evidence.note: scanx: Novelis Q1 FY27 net income +71% to $164M
Novelis produced first coil at Bay Minette plant

exposures.mechanism: Direct India-to-US exports are small and Novelis US production is largely domestic, so tariff exposure runs through aluminium duties / Midwest premium, which is mixed for Novelis (scrap spread up, can-sheet pricing sticky). Low weight.

evidence.note: Trade Brains: Novelis drives revenue growth but creates risks

exposures.mechanism: Consolidated interest Rs3,692 cr TTM; mostly fixed/USD debt so the earnings channel is small; discount-rate channel for a beta~1 cyclical dominates: +25bp repo => ~-0.6.
India downstream (foil, extrusions, rolled, copper cathode/rods, ~15% of EBITDA) grows ~1.5x GDP; +1pp GDP => +1.5% volumes => ~+1.2% equity including operating leverage.

Escalation hits Gulf smelters (EGA Al Taweelah restarting, 50% done 2026-10-21), lifting aluminium (captured in F_ALUMINIUM), but raises caustic soda, CP coke, LNG and freight costs and triggers risk-off in cyclicals. Net of the aluminium channel: mildly negative; de-escalation and full Al Taweelah restart (Q1 2027) are the current price headwind.

evidence.note: CNBC TV18: EGA restarts 50% of smelter; Axis sees $2,800 in CY27
AL Circle: aluminium futures $3,050, lowest since February

exposures.mechanism: New broad duties on Chinese aluminium flat-rolled/foil imports support India downstream margins (downstream ~15% of EBITDA). No specific 2026 action found; model knowledge.

supply_chain.note: ~55% of revenue, ~40% of EBITDA (model knowledge); Oswego recovery, Bay Minette first coil 2026-10-07
